user.title: HA-liday Show
user.description: Where HA-liday Show runs. On the Home Assistant app, keep 127.0.0.1 and 8099. For Docker or pipx, give that computer's address and port, and the password you set with HALIDAY_SHOW_PASSWORD (if any).

hassio_confirm.title: HA-liday Show
hassio_confirm.description: Add HA-liday Show to Home Assistant? Its show, playlist, scene and season entities move across from MQTT, keeping their names, so your automations keep working.

reauth_confirm.title: HA-liday Show password
reauth_confirm.description: HA-liday Show's password has changed. Enter the new one.

error.cannot_connect: HA-liday Show isn't answering at that address. Check it's running, and the address and port.
error.too_old: Update the HA-liday Show app first: this integration needs a newer version.

abort.already_configured: HA-liday Show is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: HA-liday Show is already set up.

play.name: Play
play.description: Plays a show, a playlist or a scene on HA-liday Show.

show.name: Show
show.description: The show's name. Give a show, a playlist or a scene.

media_player.name: Speaker
media_player.description: A show only: play its song on this speaker instead of its own.

start_at.name: Start at
start_at.description: A show only: start this many seconds in.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops what's playing (a show, a playlist or a scene).

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Ends the visitor's pick that's playing; the next one waiting starts.

season.name: Season props
season.description: Puts a season's props out, or packs them away.

season.name: Season
season.description: The season's name, such as Halloween.

out.name: Out
out.description: On: the props are out. Off: packed away.
